notes.title: Sunny From Naughty Tales of Rabbits joins the party!
notes.content:
Crossover? Crossover! Out now is a Gold version exclusive update that adds Sunny from Naughty Tale of Rabbits as a new party member. It's the biggest crossover since Super Smash Bros! And there's a lot more smashing in this game than that one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/c97bf40c1d0bd6274e2ebb5e3b627b19bdc190a8.png[/img]

I've been a fan Hassel's games for a while. so when I figured out that we were both under the TinyHat label, making crossover content immeadiatly jumped to mind. And here it is! Sunny is designed as bonus content. She won't affect the story and is only usable if you pick the new Bunny difficulty mode. She has some new scenes with new art, as well as lots of in battle gropes inspired by the town gropes you can do with her in her home game. I had a lot of fun writing this update, so I hope you all enjoy playing it.

Next up is the Femboy Carwyn update, coming in August. And if you missed it, Netoria Tactics 2 has a Steam page up! So go and wishlist it so you know when that bad boy is released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/62b27d01c6c1ff993c714cbfac8a1900f1a6c469.png[/img]


Changelog:
Added the new Bunny difficulty, which adds Sunny from Naughty Tale of Rabbits as a new party member!
Added five new sex scenes plus variations for Sunny on various routes
Added lots and lots of gropes for Sunny

notes.title: Netoria Tactics 2 Is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/437950e9a0958773471ae2f4a52dc903aeb4a761.jpg[/img]

It's been a year since Netoria Tactics: Revolution Gold launched on Steam, and in just a few months, Netoria Tactics 2 is launching as well! This initial release will be the first 10 levels containing Act 1, the first half of the game. The game will release in early access, with Act 2 to come over the next year or two.

We've still got a couple of updates to push out for Netoria Tactics 1, such as the femboy content mentioned in previous patch notes. So even before Netoria Tactics 2 is ready to release, there is plenty of content headed your way.

Netoria Tactics 2 is a brand new story with the same SRPG gameplay and combat based story decisions as its predecessor. The goal of the game is to take what didn't work in the first game and improve it while keeping what people enjoyed. New features include:
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/c9b845c3513c78d90b7b76ce5cb50d21ddc5cc9a.png[/img]

[*] Selectable protagonist. You can play the game from the perspective of any of the four main characters, changing the story, character classes, and levels.
[*] Improved combat system with equipable character skills and an inventory management system.
[*] A much bigger budget allowing for more art and better art.
[*] Engine improvements and quality of life tweaks. 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575420/Netoria_Tactics_2/

The store page is up, so make sure to go and wishlist and follow the game to be ready to play when it releases! Thanks to everyone who enjoyed Netoria Tactics: Revolution. I hope this sequel proves just as enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/f4d93461cd73c01857e75614c504af89dfe50ad0.png[/img]

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements, Achievements, and More!
notes.content:
Netoria Tactics has a new publisher, TinyHat Studios! What does this mean for the game? It means more publicity, more support, and most importantly for the players, more content!

That's right, [b]Netoria Tactics: Revolution is getting some new updates.[/b]

The first is out right now with Steam [b]Achievements,[/b] [b]Trading Cards,[/b] and [b]Quality of Life Improvements.[/b] The next is coming in May with a crossover update with another TinyHat published game, Naughty Tale of Rabbits.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653260/Naughty_Tales_of_Rabbits__A_Cuckold_RPG/?curator_clanid=35401591

Sunny from Naughty Tale of Rabbits will be joining the game as a playable character! If you pick the new "Bunny" difficulty, she'll join the party as she tries to get back home to her world and her boyfriend. Sunny's combat kit is all based around gropes, lots and lots of gropes. She'll also have a few scenes outside of combat with the other characters. She can join Carwyn's harem in the golden route, join an orgy with Gwen and the guys on Gwen's slut route, and more!

And then a few months later, the femboy Carwyn update is happening! Yes, the confirmed, then cancelled femboy route is now reconfirmed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/cd1bdb409a566b842866d319885c1a67e4a0e589.png[/img]
Due to the additional support we've been able to get for Netoria Tactics 1,[b] I've decided to delay Netoria Tactics 2 until the Fall.[/b] We will be using this additional time not only to [b]add new content to Netoria Tactics 1[/b], but also to [b]prepare some of the new Steam platform features for Netoria Tactics 2 at launch.[/b] For now, here's the full change log of everything we've worked on!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards
[*] The load command is now always available instead of being hidden in the options
[*] Character sprites now appear next to the preview battle window
[*] You no longer have to confirm a battle start
[*] Added the option to change the difficulty level in the base
[*] Items are no longer separated by weapon type in the item stash
[*] Various other minor improvements
[/list]

4/23/2025 Hotfix:
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Saves are now supported!
[/list]

notes.title: Carwyn Triumphant
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has bought and enjoyed the Steam version of Netoria Tactics: Revolution. I truly appreciate all the support and feedback. As a thanks for making this release of the game a success, I've made a new update, the Carwyn Triumphant route.

This new update contains a brand new route, one where Carwyn achieves all his dreams and goals. And also gets to fuck two girls at he same time. This new route is different from the others as it has its own set of levels and own story. Mid-game it splits off from the main game into it's own separate side story. Cythraul? Never even meet the guy. Owain, Mordrid, and Emrys? Kicked to the curb. Join Carwyn and his two lovers, Gwen and Vivian, along with Kobold Joe as they journey to save Carwyn's home.

This will be the last major update to Netoria Tactics: Revolution. Development time has shifted to a new project, its sequel Netoria Tactics 2. More news on that project coming soon.

Changelog:
Added the Carwyn Triumphant route including:
[list]
[*] Eight new sex scenes
[*] Five new levels
[*] Unique epilogue and ending
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Carwyn sometimes carrying over infinite movement to combat levels
[*] Fixed some instances of Gwen not spawning in camp at all
[*] Fixed some errors in gropes showing the wrong particpants or giving the effects to the wrong people
[*] Fixed a number of typos
[/list]
